title: ShieldCare Premium Tariff Schedule
content:
## Schedule 1: premium rates in force by plan

The premium for a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is set plan by plan. Sold for a
single payment, the premium for the whole term is the percentage of the covered item price
entered below. Held on instalments, the premium billed for each month is the money figure
entered below. A percentage of 0.0, or a monthly figure of 0.00, records that the method of
collection beside it is not offered on that plan, and the column of collection methods
states in words what each plan offers. The last column records whether the plan applies the
Circle membership discount to the premium.

| Plan | Single payment, percent of covered item price | Monthly premium, USD | Premium may be collected as | Membership discount applied |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 9.0 | 0.00, not offered | single payment only | yes |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 14.0 | 8.99 | single payment or monthly instalment | yes |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 19.5 | 14.99 | single payment or monthly instalment | yes |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 17.0 | 21.99 | single payment or monthly instalment | yes |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 12.5 | 12.99 | single payment or monthly instalment | yes |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 0.0, not offered | 39.00 | monthly instalment only | no |

### Notes to the schedule

1. The two rate columns are alternatives, not additions: a plan is held either for a single
   payment or on instalments, and the figure that does not apply to the method chosen is
   entered as nothing.
2. ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour is a single-payment plan only, so it carries no
   monthly figure. ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection is an instalment plan only, so it
   carries no single-payment percentage.
3. The membership discount column records only whether a plan applies the discount. The one
   plan that does not apply it is ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.

### Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take a covered item recorded at a purchase price of 600.00 and a ShieldCare Accidental
Damage Plus plan sold for a single payment. The premium for the whole term is 14.0 percent
of 600.00, which comes to 84.00. Had the same customer taken the plan on instalments
instead, the figure billed for each month would be 21.99 only on ShieldCare Home Theatre
Premium; on ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus it is 8.99.
